newsitem.title: USA: GTE Corp seeks review of FCC service order.
newsitem.headline: GTE Corp seeks review of FCC service order.

text.p: GTE Corp filed a petition for review on Wednesday of the Federal Communications Commission's universal service order in the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit.

"GTE is challenging the FCC's universal service order because that order fails to ensure that quality services will be provided at affordable prices to customers in rural and poor areas," GTE's general counsel William Barr said in a statement.
GTE said the FCC order opens the way for phone companies to select only the most lucrative customers and undermines affordable phone service.
GTE has taken no position regarding a challenge to the schools and libraries provisions of the FCC's universal service order.
